parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
ResourceContainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups'
| project value = name, label = strcat(name, '  (', subscriptionId, ')')
| order by label asc

parameters.name: VirtualMachine
parameters.label: Virtual machines
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where '{ResourceGroup:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| project value = id, label = strcat(name, '  (', resourceGroup, ' / ', location, ')')
| order by label asc

parameters.name: ShowOnlyCompatibleImages
parameters.label: Show only compatible images
parameters.description: Yes shows only images matching the OS metadata rules. No also includes FALSE and UNKNOWN results; metadata matches do not prove guest driver readiness.

content.json:
### RequiresAction
**TRUE (orange):** The VM is a **MANA candidate now** and at least one NIC has Accelerated Networking enabled, or NIC visibility for that candidate is incomplete and must be checked. **FALSE (green):** The VM is not a current MANA candidate (Timeline under review or UNKNOWN), or all its attached NICs are visible and explicitly report Accelerated Networking disabled. Read access to the VM and every attached NIC is required to evaluate NIC state. FALSE means no action under this rule, not proven MANA readiness or complete evidence.

### MANA candidate status
**MANA candidate now:** Dv5/Dsv5/Ddv5/Ddsv5/Dlsv5/Dldsv5, Ev5/Esv5/Edv5/Edsv5, Dpsv6/Dpdsv6/Dplsv6/Dpldsv6, Epsv6/Epdsv6. **Timeline under review:** Dv4/Dsv4/Ddv4/Ddsv4, Ev4/Esv4/Edv4/Edsv4, Dv3/Dsv3/Ev3/Esv3, Bsv2, Dv2/Dsv2/Av2, F/Fs/Fsv2, G/GS, Ls. **UNKNOWN:** Any SKU not in those lists; this does not mean unsupported. Classification is based on the supplied family list, not actual host hardware. All SKU generations can appear; the existing supported-OS and scope filters still apply. Only MANA candidate now can produce RequiresAction=TRUE.

**Accelerated Networking:** Enabled means at least one NIC reports acceleration enabled. Disabled means all expected NICs are visible and explicitly report it disabled. UNKNOWN means NIC metadata is missing or incomplete. This column shows NIC configuration independently of MANA candidate status.

**Show only compatible images:** Yes (default) shows only MANAOSSupported=TRUE metadata matches. No also includes FALSE and UNKNOWN images. This is not a guest driver check; RequiresAction still uses VM family and NIC evidence independently of OS compatibility.

content.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where '{ResourceGroup:label}' == 'All' or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where '{VirtualMachine:label}' == 'All' or id in~ ({VirtualMachine})
| extend SourceSize=tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), OSType=tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), GuestOSName=tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.osName), GuestOSVersion=tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.osVersion), ImagePublisher=tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.publisher), ImageOffer=tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.offer), ImageSku=tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.sku), ImageVersion=tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.version), ImageId=tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.id)
| extend MANACandidateStatus=case(tolower(SourceSize) matches regex @'^standard_(d[0-9]+(s|d|ds|ls|lds)?_v5|e[0-9]+(s|d|ds)?_v5|d[0-9]+(ps|pds|pls|plds)_v6|e[0-9]+(ps|pds)_v6)$', 'MANA candidate now', tolower(SourceSize) matches regex @'^standard_(d[0-9]+(s|d|ds)?_v4|e[0-9]+(s|d|ds)?_v4|[de][0-9]+s?_v3|b[0-9]+s_v2|ds?[0-9]+_v2|a[0-9]+m?_v2|f[0-9]+(s(_v2)?)?|gs?[0-9]+|l[0-9]+s)$', 'Timeline under review', 'UNKNOWN')
| extend SourceOSImage=case(not(isempty(ImagePublisher) and isempty(ImageOffer) and isempty(ImageSku)), strcat(ImagePublisher, ':', ImageOffer, ':', ImageSku, ':', ImageVersion), not(isempty(GuestOSName)), strcat(GuestOSName, ' ', GuestOSVersion), not(isempty(ImageId)), ImageId, OSType), ImageText=tolower(strcat(ImagePublisher, ' ', ImageOffer, ' ', ImageSku, ' ', ImageVersion, ' ', GuestOSName, ' ', GuestOSVersion))
| extend OSMetadataAvailable=not(isempty(ImagePublisher) and isempty(ImageOffer) and isempty(ImageSku) and isempty(GuestOSName) and isempty(GuestOSVersion))
| extend MANAOSSupported=case(ImageText matches regex @'windows.?server.{0,30}(2016|2019|2022|2025)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'windows.{0,15}11', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'(azure.?linux|cbl.?mariner).{0,30}(3|4)([._ -]0)?', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'(alma|almalinux).{0,30}(9[._ -]6|10[._ -]0)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'debian.{0,30}(12|13)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'(oracle.?linux).{0,40}(uek.{0,5}(7|8)|9([._ -][0-9]+)?|10([._ -][0-9]+)?)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'rocky.{0,30}(9[._ -]6|10[._ -]0)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'(rhel|red.?hat).{0,30}(9[._ -]6|10[._ -]0)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'(sles|suse).{0,30}(15.{0,10}sp[._ -]?(5|6|7)|16)', 'TRUE', ImageText matches regex @'ubuntu.{0,30}(22[._ -]04|24[._ -]04)', 'TRUE', not(OSMetadataAvailable), 'UNKNOWN', 'FALSE')
| where '{ShowOnlyCompatibleImages}' == 'false' or MANAOSSupported == 'TRUE'
| extend VMId=tolower(id), ExpectedNICCount=array_length(properties.networkProfile.networkInterfaces)
| join kind=leftouter (
    Resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces'
    | extend VMId=tolower(tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id)), AcceleratedNetworking=tobool(properties.enableAcceleratedNetworking)
    | where isnotempty(VMId)
    | summarize EnabledNICs=countif(AcceleratedNetworking == true), KnownNICs=countif(isnotnull(AcceleratedNetworking)) by VMId
) on VMId
| extend AcceleratedNetworking=case(coalesce(EnabledNICs, 0) > 0, 'Enabled', coalesce(ExpectedNICCount, 0) > 0 and coalesce(KnownNICs, 0) == ExpectedNICCount, 'Disabled', 'UNKNOWN')
| extend RequiresAction=MANACandidateStatus == 'MANA candidate now' and (coalesce(EnabledNICs, 0) > 0 or isnull(ExpectedNICCount) or ExpectedNICCount == 0 or coalesce(KnownNICs, 0) != ExpectedNICCount)
| project VMName=name, SubscriptionID=subscriptionId, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, SourceSize, MANAOSSupported, RequiresAction=iff(RequiresAction, 'TRUE', 'FALSE'), MANACandidateStatus, AcceleratedNetworking, OSType, GuestOSName, GuestOSVersion, SourceOSImage, ResourceId=id
| order by ResourceGroup asc, VMName asc
